sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo; everything turns round on sitting
up in bed. Heat at vertex; stitches from vertex down
limbs into abdomen and genitals. Sore painful spots
on head. Painful pulsation in forehead.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:

After menses, yellow leucorrhoejf ivith severe backache.
When pain in back ceases, the discharge gushes out.
Sore pain between labia during urination. Pruritus pu-
clendi; labia swollen.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text: Cramps in the calves; worse at night.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Sacrum pains, as if broken. Severe back-
ache; must lean against something for support. Pains
extended into pelvis.
